params.body:
Trends now go on gentells.com by rule: live, seen at least five times on platforms, the newest at most 30 days old. A person can take one off. The Overview's "Put on gentells.com" button belonged to the approval step, which is gone.

## What changes

- **Overview** (`src/pages/Overview.jsx`):
  - each trend card says where it stands, as one of three states:
    - "Online on gentells.com";
    - "Taken off gentells.com";
    - "Offline: seen too seldom or not lately on platforms";
  - the desk tile counts what is online and states the rules;
  - the Put action is removed.
- **Trend page** (`src/pages/InsightDetail.jsx`):
  - "On the site" shows Online, Taken off or Offline, with the rules;
  - the actions are "Take it off the site" and "Put it back".

- **e2e**: the mocks give each Overview card a site state (`online`, `offline`) and the site rules. The specs check the badges and the desk tile, and that "Put on gentells.com" is gone.

This replaces #140, whose e2e run failed on the removed button and the old wording.

## Tests

- `npx playwright test`: 96 of 96.
- `npm run build` passes.
params.title: Overview and trend page: online by rule
